hints.title: Scores Collection
hints.text: Store incoming scores and prepare to select the highest k elements dynamically.

hints.title: Top-K Selection
hints.text: Use a min-priority queue of size k or a selection algorithm to retrieve the k largest values.

hints.title: Average Computation
hints.text: Compute the sum of the top k elements and divide by k in floating point precision.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) add, O(N log K) query
variables: K: number of top scores queried
complexity.notes: Bounded priority queue yields efficient top-k retrieval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full array sorting on every query costs O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bounded heap or selection routine to compute top k average.
